interactions.name: Open Cadence from a delivered notification
interactions.intent: Open the intended Occurrence from a delivered Cadence notification.
interactions.availability: Available after a Cadence notification is delivered. Web protected routes may require sign-in. Desktop accepts only a native product notification with an exact cadence.local UUID target.
interactions.success_result: Web focuses or opens the same-origin target. Desktop opens Timeline, reads the owned Occurrence independently of the visible date range, expands and focuses its existing row or a reminder context row, and preserves the current status, Note, and timing controls. Exact native delivery evidence is retained for local history without claiming user receipt or reading.
interactions.failure_result: Web cross-origin targets fall back to /timeline. Desktop ignores malformed or bench identifiers; a missing Occurrence shows unavailable text and a storage error remains an error. Failed delivery-history persistence keeps evidence for retry and leaves reminder verification unavailable.

test_coverage.notes: Existing-window navigation/focus and new-window opening are executed against the service worker source. Desktop tests cover strict identifier parsing, exact owner lookup, past/resolved/archived and out-of-range targets, shared row semantics, missing/error results, and unique disclosure IDs. An owner-clicked native product notification opened and focused its exact Occurrence; Tab reached that row's Track Time control. DOM tests verify repeated activation, missing-target focus, and no focus theft during ordinary refresh. Separate OS sleep/wake evidence now verifies automatic post-wake reconciliation before GUI inspection.
